messages:
sophie: Quick POC question from FinTech prospect — they require BYO-HSM + customer-managed keys (CMK) for model encryption and want a strict 30d rotation cadence. Can we confirm our supported rotation modes and whether we can do automated rotation with a dual-control ceremony?
lee: We support CMK via our Private connector + PKCS#11 and CloudHSM style imports. Automated rotation is possible but dual-control (human threshold signing) is typically customer-side — we can trigger and validate via API hooks.
amal: Security check — they want attestation artifacts (certified HSM quote, MAA/attestation, and signed key import receipts). Can Redwood produce signed proof of key wrapping and import timestamps?
ben: We can emit signed audit entries and time-stamped key import logs to the customer's audit sink (S3/siem). Attestation doc depends on HSM vendor — we support attestation blobs for Nitro/CloudHSM and can surface them in the audit export.
sophie: They also need an SLA for key access latency: <=50ms  p50 for unbatched requests. If key op latency exceeds that, they want credits. Is that something we can commit to on Dedicated/Private?
pricing-bot: FYI — dedicated/private HSM support typically has a surcharge: per-lookup or throughput-unit pricing + setup. I'll pull a ballpark.
lee: Practically, 50ms p50 is tight if you force every token envelope key to hit HSM. We recommend envelope encryption with a short-lived DEK cached in memory on the inference node (and rotated every N mins) so HSM calls are only at DEK rotation or import. That keeps per-token latency low while meeting KMS audit/rotation requirements.
sophie: Customer insists on no long-lived DEKs in Redwood-managed memory > 15m. Can we support DEK TTL = 15m + prefix caching and KV cache invalidation on rotation?
ben: Yes. We can configure DEK TTL=15m and immediate invalidation on key rotation. Need to confirm their allowed cache drift and whether they want proactive invalidation webhooks.
amal: Also need to confirm BYO-HSM replication constraints — they require geo-redundant HSM mirrored between eu-west-1 and us-east-1 and deterministic failover for key retrieval. How do we route key ops cross-region?
lee: Our Private connector can be deployed in multiple regions and has a routing policy for key ops. We can do primary->secondary with synchronous or async replication depending on vendor. For strict determinism they need synchronous mirroring at the HSM level (vendor feature). We can document failover plan.
sophie: They asked for an example Redwood config snippet for the POC (how to wire external KMS). Can you paste one I can send?
lee: Sure — send this (replace placeholders):
```
external_kms: {
  provider: "customer-hsm",
  connector: "private-agent-v1",
  pkcs11_module: "/usr/lib/libcloudhsm_pkcs11.so",
  key_alias: "projects/finco/keys/llm-infer-key",
  key_wrapping: "rsa-oaep-sha256",
  rotation_days: "30",
  dek_ttl_seconds: "900"  # 15m
}
```
sophie: perfect. also — they want the key import flow for an offline key ceremony (customer generates the key material and imports). Steps?
ben: Short flow: 1) Generate key offline -> 2) Export wrapped key using vendor import token format -> 3) Upload to Redwood Private import API -> 4) Redwood connector calls HSM vendor import via PKCS#11/Manufacturer API -> 5) Import audit record + attestation blob returned. We'll provide a runbook for the POC.
amal: Add requirement: HSM tamper-evidence photos and dual-signature of import bundle for legal/compliance. Will need manual steps in runbook.
sophie: Pricing question from legal: is there a per-request HSM egress surcharge when using BYO-HSM through Private connector? They want to model costs at 100M inference requests/month.
pricing-bot: estimate: fixed connector + per-request HSM op fee. Rough ballpark: $Xk/month fixed + $0.00002 per HSM lookup. I'll send exact numbers after quoting throughput.
sophie: Can we support graceful fallback to Redwood-managed keys if their HSM is unreachable (with 30m cooldown and customer approval)? They want HA but also strict access controls.
amal: Security constraint: fallback to Redwood-managed keys requires written policy and explicit customer opt-in and must be auditable. Can't be enabled silently.
lee: We support policy-based fallbacks: prefer BYO-HSM, then fallback to Redwood-wrapped CMK only if customer has pre-approved fallback and only for a configured time window. All fallback events are logged and can trigger alerts.
sophie: last bit — can we get an SOW snippet and a POC checklist to share with the customer (network, port requirements, certs, test vectors)?
ben: I'll assemble a POC checklist (network diagrams, port 443 egress endpoints, mutual TLS cert exchange, test vectors for envelope flow, and a timeline).
sophie: amazing, pls drop checklist + pricing + attestation examples into this thread when ready. I'll loop in the customer's PM after that. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: private-connector-v1 -> canary 2/3 nodes. No impact expected.
pricing-bot: posted initial estimate to the sales-doc link: https://redwood.example.com/sales/byo-hsm-estimates (internal)
sophie: thanks everyone — will wait for checklist and docs and then schedule the customer sync.
